actions.name: send_custom_log
actions.title: Send custom log
actions.description: Send custom log to Azure Monitor
actions.help: Sends log data to Azure Monitor.

actions.name: send_log_injection
actions.title: Inject custom logs
actions.description: Inject custom log events into a specified Azure Monitor DCR stream
actions.help: Use this action to send custom log events to a specified Azure Monitor Data Collection Rule (DCR) stream. You can define the structure of the log events using the Log schema field. The log events will be sent to the specified DCR stream, which can be a custom steam.Note: Only works with Client Crede…

input.name: data_collection_rule_id
input.label: Data collection rule ID
input.hint: The unique identifier of the Data Collection Rule in your Azure subscription.

input.name: stream_name
input.label: Stream name
input.hint: The name of the event stream defined on the DCR where logs will be sent. for custom streams, you can use the format Custom- . For example, if your stream name is my_custom_stream , you can use Custom-…

input.name: api_version
input.label: API version
input.hint: Select the Azure Monitor Logs API version (defaults to the latest).

input.name: events_schema
input.label: Log schema
input.hint: Design the shape of each log record—add fields to match the properties you’ll send.
